# 20 Questions Film

> > A filmmaking resource exploring creative production design, practical effects, and low-budget visual storytelling techniques.

20 Questions Film provides inspiration and practical guidance for filmmakers, production designers, and visual artists working with limited resources. The site focuses on innovative approaches to set design, lighting, and installation art that can elevate independent film production.

## Key Topics

- production design
- set design
- lighting techniques
- practical effects
- low-budget filmmaking
- installation art
- creative inspiration
- smoke bombs
- LED lighting
- lasers
- spheres
- David Ogle
- Andrew Brooks
- visual storytelling

## Production Design & Practical Effects

- [Production Designers, Grab Your Spheres, Smoke Bombs, LEDs & Lasers](https://20questionsfilm.com/production-designers-grab-your-spheres-smoke-bombs-leds-lasers/): Creative production design tips using practical effects and lighting
